title: Independent Living Residency Agreement — Article on Monthly Billing and Partial Months
content:
## Article 4 — Monthly billing

4.1 **Billing in advance.** Monthly fees under the Independent Living Residency Agreement are billed in advance on the fee due day of each calendar month for that whole month: one base fee charge of the contracted monthly service fee, and one second person fee charge of the second person fee of the apartment type while the occupancy is double.

4.2 **Partial months.** Any span shorter than a whole calendar month — the move-in month, a mid-month rate change, a mid-month occupancy change or the month in which fees end — is prorated.

4.3 **Retired daily-amount clause.** The clause of 4.2 under which the daily amount was the monthly amount divided by the actual number of days in that calendar month, multiplied by the days billed counted inclusive of both the first and last day, and rounded once to the cent half up, is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current proration basis of the agreement.

4.4 **Split spans.** A mid-month change splits the month into separately billed spans, each with its own service-from date, so that no day is billed twice for the same component.

4.5 **Status.** Monthly fee charges may be posted only while the residency is in active or notice given status.

4.6 **Absence.** Monthly fees continue unchanged while the resident is away from the apartment for any reason; independent living has no absence credit.

## Components of a full month

| Occupancy during the whole month | Charges billed on the fee due day |
|---|---|
| Single | One base fee charge of the contracted monthly service fee |
| Double | One base fee charge of the contracted monthly service fee and one second person fee charge of the second person fee of the apartment type |

## Questions answered by this article

**Does a resident who spends three weeks with family receive a reduced fee?** No. Monthly fees continue unchanged while the resident is away for any reason; there is no absence credit.

**What happens to the spans when a second occupant moves in on the 16th?** The month is split into separately billed spans, each with its own service-from date, so that no day is billed twice for the same component.

**Can a monthly fee charge be posted on a residency that is vacated?** No. Monthly fee charges may be posted only while the residency is active or notice given.
